answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, like planting a cedar or a walnut tree in a shared orchard: each identity costs real capital to grow, so spawning thousands of fakes drains the attacker funds. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and redistributed to honest peers, turning a Sybil farm into a money-losing orchard while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
